legal.draftNotice: Draft — pending legal review. This placeholder copy is not yet reviewed legal text and should not be relied on as binding.
legal.termsIntro: These Terms of Service govern your use of Rally, an event registration platform. By creating an account or using Rally, you agree to these terms.
legal.termsScopeBody: Rally provides an online platform for discovering, registering, and paying for events organized by third parties (Organizers). Rally's responsibilities are limited to facilitating event registration and payment processing, providing refund support in accordance with organizer cancellation policies, and customer support during business hours. Rally is not responsible for organizer conduct, event quality, participant injuries, weather-related event changes, event cancellations or rescheduling by organizers, or accuracy of event schedules.
legal.termsAccountsBody: You're required to provide accurate personal data including name, email, phone, and profile information. You must be old enough to enter into a binding agreement in your jurisdiction. You consent to Rally storing, accessing, and processing your personal data for platform operations.
legal.termsEligibilityBody: By using Rally, you guarantee your use is for personal, legal purposes and you are of legal age to enter into binding agreements. You are solely responsible for any harm or misinterpretation of the platform's content.
legal.termsLinksBody: Rally may contain links to third-party websites including organizer sites and payment providers. By accessing these third-party sites, you consent to their terms and conditions. Rally has no control over and cannot assume responsibility for third-party practices.
legal.termsPaymentsBody: Registration payments are processed through PayWay, our payment partner. By completing payment, you agree to PayWay's terms and guarantee the payment method belongs to you. Your card will be debited once you receive email confirmation. Rally supports various payment methods as listed on the platform.
legal.termsRegistrationBody: Rally provides instant registration when capacity is available. For events with waitlists, your registration is confirmed only when promoted from the waitlist. Registration confirmations are sent via email and app notification.
legal.termsPromoBody: Promotional codes are rewards for percentage discounts on Rally purchases. They must be used for the intended recipient and purpose, cannot be duplicated or transferred, are not valid for cash, and may expire. Rally reserves the right to terminate promotional codes for misuse.
legal.termsCancellationBody: Cancellation policies vary by event and are set by organizers. Refund decisions are made by event organizers. Weather-related cancellations may occur for outdoor events. Waitlist promotion is available for full events. No-show policies may apply. Contact support for cancellation requests.
legal.termsRefundBody: Refunds are processed based on event-specific policies and organizer decisions. Refunds are processed through PayWay to the original payment method. Non-refundable scenarios include cancellations after event start, no-shows, and user-provided incorrect information. Rally reserves the right to modify refund policies.
legal.termsConductBody: You may not use Rally to defraud others, collect payments for events you don't intend to hold, or engage in activity that endangers people or violates the law.
legal.termsTerminationBody: Rally may suspend or terminate accounts, and suspend events, that violate these terms. A suspended event cannot be republished by its organizer — only Rally can reverse a suspension.
legal.termsContactBody: Questions about these terms can be sent to admin@rails-dev.com or call +855 12 583 587 during business hours.
legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy describes how Rally collects, uses, and shares information when you use the platform.
legal.privacyCollectBody: We collect the information you provide when creating an account or registering for an event (name, email, phone), along with event and payment records.
legal.privacyUseBody: We use this information to operate Rally: creating accounts, processing registrations and payments, sending confirmation and notification emails, and moderating the platform.
legal.privacySharingBody: Event organizers can see the registration details of people registered for their own events. We don't sell personal information to third parties.
legal.privacyRetentionBody: We retain account and registration data for as long as your account is active, and as needed to comply with legal obligations.
legal.privacyContactBody: Questions about this policy can be sent to the email address associated with your Rally account's support channel.
